1. Topic - This paper addresses the impact of beam shape on print accuracy in digital light processing additive manufacturing.
2. Problem - It aims to resolve issues with the existing Gaussian model's inability to accurately predict print outcomes.
3. Method - An alternative model based on a heavy-tailed Lorentzian distribution is proposed, along with a calibration method for beam distribution parameters from single-layer print measurements.
4. Key Result - The Lorentzian model demonstrates improved accuracy in predicting small build areas and better estimates of the printer's XY-axis resolution.
5. Takeaway - Thus, the key message is that modifications to beam distribution can prevent errors in microchannel formation and enhance prediction accuracy in printing outcomes.
